name: Designing for iPhone Duo
summary: Apple HIG page on designing apps for the dual-display iPhone Duo: adaptive layouts, device poses and split views.
description: A Human Interface Guidelines page for iPhone Duo, an iPhone with inner and outer displays joined by a center hinge. It covers the device's anatomy (displays, cameras, hinge), poses, best practices for resizing and cross-display continuity, dynamic layouts, reserved regions, split views, arrangement views and vertical controls, plus a change log.
